RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making a claim of sex discrimination legally unviable and professionally counterproductive. An all-female panel hiring a woman provides no evidence of sex bias against you. 

Senior leadership roles like Head of Risk Modelling heavily weigh regulatory governance, supervisory relations, and model risk management frameworks (such as SR 11-7) alongside quantitative expertise. The bank likely prioritized her regulatory background over purely technical depth. 

Do not mention the panel's gender composition; doing so appears baseless and could harm your professional standing. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused strictly on skills and experience to help guide your future applications.
